metadata.name: cross_settle
metadata.description: Opening Cross settlement adapters. First adapter: Meteora DBC continuation at the clearing price (ADR-0006).

instructions.name: bind_dbc_mint
docs: Step 2: install the open-mode hook config, hand the mint authority to the cross and bind
the mint in `cross_core`. Permissionless once step 1 has run; the payer funds rent.

instructions.name: claim_partner_fee
docs: Claims the DBC partner's trading fees (the settler PDA is the partner) to an account owned by the
cross's protocol fee recipient. Permissionless: nobody chooses the destination (ADR-0480).

accounts.name: base_destination
docs: Receives the partner's base-token fees; must belong to the fee recipient.

accounts.name: quote_destination
docs: Receives the partner's quote-token fees; must belong to the fee recipient.

instructions.name: claim_partner_pool_creation_fee
docs: Claims the pool-creation fee the partner is owed, in lamports, to the fee recipient's wallet.

instructions.name: claim_pol_fees
docs: Claims the fees of the protocol-owned DAMM v2 position a DBC migration leaves with the settler, to
accounts owned by the cross's `proceeds_to` (ADR-0482).

accounts.name: token_a_destination
docs: Receives the pool's token-A fees; must belong to the cross's `proceeds_to`.

accounts.name: token_b_destination
docs: Receives the pool's token-B fees; must belong to the cross's `proceeds_to`.

instructions.name: create_greenshoe
docs: Commits a budget (at least 10% of what the cross raised) to standing bids under P* for a week (ADR-0487).

instructions.name: deploy_greenshoe_bid
docs: Places one level of the greenshoe as a DLMM limit order owned by the program. Permissionless.

accounts.name: limit_order
docs: The new limit-order account; it signs once so DLMM can create it.

instructions.name: finish_greenshoe
docs: Burns everything the bids bought and returns the unspent budget to the issuer's proceeds. Permissionless.

accounts.name: proceeds_quote
docs: Receives what the bids did not spend; must belong to the cross's `proceeds_to`.

instructions.name: open_dbc_pool
docs: Step 1: create the DBC config and pool at the clearing price. Only the cross creator may
call it, because the curve shape and fees are the issuer's choice; the start price is not.

instructions.name: open_dbc_pool_locked
docs: `open_dbc_pool` for the fair-launch design (ADR-0482): the same curve, but the program refuses a
config under which anyone could withdraw the opening liquidity, or whose migrated pool is not
compounding. Everything `open_dbc_pool` checks is checked here too. `args` is the Borsh encoding
of `open_dbc_pool`'s two arguments, `config_parameters` then `pool`, one after the other, so
`open_dbc_pool`'s own argument types stay what they were.

instructions.name: open_dlmm_pair
docs: DLMM adapter: opens a Meteora DLMM pair for the cross's market whose active bin is the
bin nearest P* (within half a bin step). Token X is the base asset and token Y the quote,
so a bin's price (Y per X) is in the cross's units. Liquidity is added afterwards by the
issuer with DLMM's own instructions; adding liquidity cannot move the active bin.

instructions.name: open_dlmm_pair_badged
docs: `open_dlmm_pair` for a pair whose mints need a Meteora Token Badge (ADR-0485): tokenized stocks carry Token-2022 extensions
(a pausable mint, a permanent delegate) that DLMM refuses without a badge. The two badge accounts follow the usual accounts, in
order base then quote, each either the mint's `TokenBadge` PDA or the DLMM program id when that mint needs none. A batch window
of zero opens the pair at once; any other window applies the rules of `open_dlmm_pair_batched`.
`params` is the Borsh encoding of `open_dlmm_pair`'s argument.

instructions.name: open_dlmm_pair_batched
docs: `open_dlmm_pair` for a batch-opened market (ADR-0483): the pair is created with a timestamp start at least
`window_secs` away, so it cannot trade until the crosses of the window have run (or, with `has_alpha_vault`, only an
Alpha Vault can buy before then), and the pair's creator can pause it.
`params` is the Borsh encoding of `open_dlmm_pair`'s argument.

instructions.name: seed_damm_v2
docs: DAMM v2 adapter: seeds a Meteora DAMM v2 pool for the cross's market at exactly P*.
Token A is the base asset and token B the quote, so DAMM's price (B per A) is the cross's
price. The issuer supplies the liquidity from its own accounts and receives the position
NFT; the adapter guarantees only that the pool opens at the price the cross discovered.

instructions.name: seed_damm_v2_batched
docs: `seed_damm_v2` for a batch-opened market (ADR-0483): the pool refuses every swap until a start the program
checks is at least `window_secs` away, its fee decays from a higher opening fee, and its fees compound
back into the pool. During the window the market clears as a series of short crosses instead of trading
against the AMM; afterwards the pool opens at the price the last cross printed.
`params` is the Borsh encoding of `seed_damm_v2`'s argument.

instructions.name: seed_raydium_cpmm
docs: Raydium CPMM adapter: opens a Raydium constant-product pool for the cross's market whose
opening price — the ratio of the two initial deposits — is P* to within one quote atom.
Raydium orders the pool's mints by key, so the base may be token 0 or token 1.

instructions.name: settle_greenshoe_level
docs: After the week: cancels a placed level, taking back the unspent quote and the base it bought. Permissionless.

instructions.name: withdraw_partner_migration_fee
docs: Withdraws the partner's slice of the DBC migration fee to an account owned by the fee recipient.

accounts.name: destination
docs: Receives the quote; must belong to the cross's `proceeds_to` (surplus) or its fee recipient
(migration fee).

instructions.name: withdraw_partner_surplus
docs: Withdraws the partner's share of the surplus quote above the migration threshold to an account
owned by the cross's `proceeds_to` (the issuer's capital, ADR-0481).

accounts.name: destination
docs: Receives the quote; must belong to the cross's `proceeds_to` (surplus) or its fee recipient
(migration fee).

errors.name: WrongCross
errors.msg: Account is not a cross_core cross

errors.name: NotCreator
errors.msg: Only the cross creator may open the DBC pool

errors.name: AlreadyBound
errors.msg: Base mint already bound

errors.name: WrongSettler
errors.msg: Cross does not name this adapter's settler

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: Quote mint does not match the cross

errors.name: NotCleared
errors.msg: Cross has not cleared

errors.name: BadConfig
errors.msg: DBC config must be Token-2022 with partner mint authority

errors.name: StartPriceNotClearingPrice
errors.msg: DBC start price must equal the clearing price

errors.name: PoolNotOpened
errors.msg: DBC pool has not been opened for this cross

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: WrongDestination
errors.msg: The destination does not belong to the account the cross names for this payout

errors.name: DesignMigration
errors.msg: The locked design requires migration into DAMM v2

errors.name: DesignNotCompounding
errors.msg: The locked design requires a compounding migrated pool with a compounding fee

errors.name: DesignUnlockedLiquidity
errors.msg: The locked design leaves liquidity withdrawable at migration

errors.name: DesignPartnerVesting
errors.msg: The settler cannot vest liquidity: partner liquidity may only be locked permanently

errors.name: DesignLockTooLow
errors.msg: The locked design requires at least 20% of the liquidity locked permanently

errors.name: WrongPair
errors.msg: Not a DLMM pair of this cross's mints that is open for trading

errors.name: GreenshoeBudget
errors.msg: The greenshoe budget is below 10% of what the cross raised, above a level's share, or exceeds the budget

errors.name: GreenshoeWindow
errors.msg: Bids are only accepted inside the greenshoe week, and the period and window parameters must be sane

errors.name: GreenshoeLevel
errors.msg: That greenshoe level is invalid, already placed, not placed, or already settled

errors.name: GreenshoeBin
errors.msg: The bid must sit in the bin nearest its level, strictly below the active bin

errors.name: GreenshoeRateLimit
errors.msg: This period's greenshoe deployment cap is used up

errors.name: GreenshoeNotExpired
errors.msg: The greenshoe week has not ended

errors.name: BadArgs
errors.msg: The argument bytes are not the Borsh encoding of the expected parameters

errors.name: BadgeAccounts
errors.msg: Pass exactly two badge accounts: base then quote, or the DLMM program id for none

errors.name: BatchWindow
errors.msg: A batch window must be between 30 seconds and 7 days

errors.name: BatchActivation
errors.msg: A batch-opened pool needs a timestamp start at least the window away

errors.name: BatchNotCompounding
errors.msg: A batch-opened DAMM v2 pool must compound its fees

errors.name: BatchFeeNotDecaying
errors.msg: A batch-opened DAMM v2 pool must open with a fee that decays over time

fields.name: reference_price
docs: P* and its scale, copied from the cross so the bids never depend on a later read.

fields.name: budget
docs: Quote committed at creation; nothing can be added and nothing leaves except as bids, refunds at expiry or burns.
